reading_notes: Only PKG-001 matches the RFX line description on both dimensions and ply exactly (18,000 pcs/mo quoted vs RFX 9,000 pcs/mo). For nearly every other RFX code, the vendor's quoted item under that same code carries different dimensions than the RFX description, and for several codes (PKG-009/010/011/012/022/023/025) the ply count also differs from what the RFX specifies. RFX-required print attributes (PKG-006 printed 1-col, PKG-013 printed 2-col, PKG-023 printed 1-col) are not confirmed anywhere in the vendor's technical spec table. 8 of 30 RFX codes (PKG-005, 015, 021, 024, 026, 028, 029, 030) were not quoted at all. The quotation and questionnaire both cite 'RFQ/PKG/2026/07' rather than the 'RFQ-FY27-CORR' event identifier supplied here; dates are consistent (response due 20 Aug 2026, quote dated 21 Aug 2026) so this is noted rather than treated as a conflict. Two internal conflicts were found between the questionnaire answers and the attached supporting certificates (ISO validity date, recycled-content percentage) — see conflicts array. Vendor's payment term offer (30 days) is shorter than the RFX's requested 45-day term.
